common.definition_note: ONS Consumer Prices Index, all items, 12-month rate (series D7G7, dataset MM23). Based on the harmonised methodology developed by Eurostat; excludes owner occupiers' housing costs.
ONS Consumer Prices Index including owner occupiers' housing costs, all items, 12-month rate (series L55O, dataset MM23). ONS's most comprehensive measure of consumer price inflation.
Official Bank Rate set by the Monetary Policy Committee, percent per annum, by the first business day each level applied in the Bank of England's daily series IUDBEDR (requested from January 1999).

ONS monthly GDP: chained-volume gross value added at basic prices, seasonally adjusted, three months to the reference month on the previous three months (series ED3H, dataset MGDP). Not a calendar quarter unless the months align.
ONS monthly GDP: chained-volume gross value added at basic prices, seasonally adjusted, month on previous month (series ECYX, dataset MGDP). The monthly GDP bulletin headlines this measure.

ONS real GDP, chained volume measure, seasonally adjusted, quarter on previous quarter; not annualised (series IHYQ). Taken from the more recently released of the first quarterly estimate (PN2) and quarterly national accounts (QNA) datasets.

ONS Labour Force Survey unemployment rate, people aged 16 and over, seasonally adjusted, average of the three months ending in the reference month (series MGSX, dataset LMS). Overlapping three-month periods are not independent.
